purpose: Side view of tri-star cluster climbing 197 mm riser: triangular plate with three 150 mm wheels pivoting over step nose, main axle path and pull direction
code_or_query:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6,5))
# steps: two steps riser 197 going 254 scaled
import matplotlib.patches as patches
riser, going = 1.97, 2.54
# draw steps
ax.plot([0, going, going],[0,0,riser],'k',lw=2)
ax.plot([going, 2*going, 2*going],[riser,riser,2*riser],'k',lw=2)
ax.text(going+0.1, riser/2, 'riser 197', fontsize=8)
ax.text(going/2, -0.3, 'going 254', fontsize=8)
# tri-star centres
import numpy as np
Rc=1.1
angles=np.deg2rad([90,210,330])
cx, cy = going-0.3, riser+1.1
for a in angles:
    wx=cx+Rc*np.cos(a); wy=cy+Rc*np.sin(a)
    c=plt.Circle((wx,wy),0.75,fill=False,lw=2)
    ax.add_patch(c)
    ax.plot([cx,wx],[cy,wy],'k--',lw=1)
ax.plot(cx,cy,'ko')
ax.text(cx+0.15,cy+0.15,'main axle',fontsize=9)
ax.text(cx-2.2,cy+1.8,'pull up/back',fontsize=9)
ax.annotate('',xy=(cx-0.5,cy+0.8),xytext=(cx-2.0,cy+1.6),arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->',lw=1.5))
ax.text(0.2,3.8,'lower tread contact',fontsize=8)
ax.text(going+0.4,riser+2.6,'lead wheel on next tread',fontsize=8)
ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
ax.set_title('tri-star cluster walks over step nose')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('sketch.png', dpi=150)
